verdict.rationale: Airbyte OSS can be self-hosted anywhere via Docker/abctl or any Kubernetes cluster, giving users full control over where data resides/is processed, which indirectly satisfies data residency needs. However, there is no explicit documentation of Airbyte Cloud offering region-selection or data-residency guarantees for customers who don't self-host. missing for 10: explicit Airbyte Cloud region/residency options, compliance certifications tied to specific geographies, and independent confirmation of residency guarantees.
